basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is recruiting for 1 Junior Research Fellow post on a contract basis. Candidates applying for this position must possess a 1st class Graduate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics and Computing, Statistics or related areas with NET/GATE qualification OR a 1st class Post-graduate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering. The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000 p.m. Plus HRA @27%. how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
Fill out the application form with complete information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division, details of work experience, and other required information.
Send the duly filled application form by email with advertisement number on the subject line to Prof. Rajendra Kumar at email id: [email protected].
Ensure the complete application reaches the email ID by 15/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
Anusandhan National Research Foundation: Science and Engineering Research Board

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements stipulated for the project position. An additional relaxation of 5% marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates as per prevailing IRD norms. Essential Qualification: 1st class Graduate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics and Computing, Statistics or related areas with NET/GATE qualification OR 1st class Post-graduate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics and Computing or related areas with NET/GATE. Desirable Qualification: Good knowledge of Algebra, Quantum Computing, and Cryptography. Additional Requirement: The requirement of NET/GATE examination for the selection to the post of JRF/SRF may be relaxed for candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The approved consolidated fellowship is Rs. 37,000 p.m. plus HRA at the rate of 27%. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post. Their name will be displayed on the web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview. In case any clarification is required on eligibility regarding the above post, the candidate may contact Prof. Rajendra Kumar at email id: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. What allowances are paid in addition to the base fellowship?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 37,000 per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) at the rate of 27%.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for a relaxation in marks?
faq.answer: A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates as per prevailing IRD norms.

faq.question: Q4. What desirable qualifications are preferred for the post?
faq.answer: Good knowledge of Algebra, Quantum Computing, and Cryptography is desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What should be mentioned in the subject line of the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send the application by email with the advertisement number on the subject line to the specified email address.
